name: LlamaIndex
summary: A data framework for putting your documents in front of a model: readers, indices, retrievers and query engines.
description:
LlamaIndex starts from the ingestion side rather than the prompt side, which is why it is the default when the hard part is the corpus: readers for hundreds of sources, document structures that survive chunking, indices and retrievers to compare, and reranking hooks. Property-graph retrieval over documents is a real capability rather than a marketing phrase.

You still own the evaluation. It will happily build a pipeline that retrieves confidently and answers badly, and the number of knobs is large enough that a baseline you can measure is the only defence. For plain question-answering over a few PDFs it is more machinery than the job needs.
